verdict.rationale: Smooth's core product is a built-in AI agent: you hand it a natural-language task such as `smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight...")` and it executes the browser work autonomously. Live view and takeover, multi-step sessions, cancel/list task management and structured outputs support the delegation flow. One community user confirms that a complex prompt was handled well. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational or UI assistant (delegation is only via SDK/API/CLI or external agents), task scope beyond web-browsing work, and broader independent verification of delegation quality.
